Existing official released-test measurements remain available on /onehar-20261028.html; those weights do not establish clean subject-held-out retraining provenance.

source.name: RobustHAR
source.note: Paper reimplementation of IJCAI PDF Eqs.1-11/Fig.2: 3 masked branches, 1-layer/8-head Transformers and frozen encoders. Equation-audited Eq.10 correlation queries with matching-branch keys/values, separate attention layers, Eq.11 matrix dot product. Revised formula/gradient/freeze and complete smoke flows passed on all five datasets. Prior variant archived/superseded; new formal five-seed runs queued. Unspecified dimensions, A, norm axis and reduction disclosed; paper calibration pending.
